# dokku_http_auth_allowed_ip (Data Source)

Manages the set of IP addresses allowed to bypass HTTP auth for a dokku application

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_http_auth_allowed_ip" "example" {
  app = "hello-world"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) Name of the app

### Read-Only

- `allowed_ips` (Set of String) List of IP addresses to allow or remove
- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
